settings.seo_title: Nitesh Jangda — Creative Director | NJ Interiors
settings.seo_description: Nitesh Jangda, Creative Director of NJ Interiors. Four generations of craftsmanship, engineering precision, and contemporary luxury interior design.
settings.seo_keywords: Nitesh Jangda, NJ Interiors, Luxury Interior Design, Creative Director, Residential Interiors, Commercial Interiors, Bespoke Furniture
settings.about_body: An Electronics Engineering graduate, Nitesh initially began his professional journey in technical support. However, his passion for creativity, architecture and interior spaces inspired him to pursue a different path. In 2016, he founded NJ Interiors, bringing together his technical knowledge, creative vision and family's rich heritage of craftsmanship.
settings.vision_quote: To create spaces that go beyond beauty — spaces that tell stories, inspire living and stand the test of time.

timeline.title: Great-Grandfather
timeline.subtitle: Civil Contracting & Structural Heritage
timeline.description: The family's journey began with Nitesh's great-grandfather, a respected civil contractor whose work laid the architectural foundation of trust, structural integrity, and enduring built environments.

timeline.title: Grandfather
timeline.subtitle: Master Carpentry Workshop
timeline.description: Followed by his grandfather's carpentry workshop, where raw timber was shaped by hand into bespoke joinery, architectural woodwork, and heirloom furniture.

timeline.title: Father — Navadurga Engineering Works
timeline.subtitle: Engineering Equipment, Steel & Architectural Metalwork
timeline.description: His father's entrepreneurial venture, Navadurga Engineering Works, specialised in engineering equipment, machinery, steel furniture, and architectural metalwork — instilling precision and industrial discipline.

timeline.title: Nitesh Jangda — NJ Interiors
timeline.subtitle: Creative Direction & Contemporary Living
timeline.description: Growing up surrounded by workshops, materials and skilled craftsmanship, Nitesh founded NJ Interiors in 2016 — uniting four generations of making with contemporary interior architecture.

projects.title: The Travertine Pavilion (Sample)
projects.summary: A sunlit contemporary living space anchored by monolithic travertine, walnut millwork, and warm bronze accents.

projects.design_concept: Quiet luxury rooted in raw natural stone, recessed linear lighting, and bespoke low-slung seating.
projects.materials_finishes: Honed Italian Travertine, Smoked American Walnut, Brushed Bronze, Bouclé Linen
